subtasks.description: Declare the complete forward S-box constant lookup table as a 256-entry byte array; must contain the standard AES S-box substitution values and serve as the single source of truth.
constraints: The 256-entry constant table must be implemented as flattened scalar wires/assignments or a flat continuous assignment; avoid unpacked arrays, multidimensional references, and generate/genvar constructs.

subtasks.description: Map the input byte sbox_byte_request to the output byte sbox_byte_response using the lookup table from B1, with purely combinational assignment; no clock, no pipeline.
constraints: Since the table is flattened, implement the output selection using a combinational case statement or equivalent explicit mapping that does not rely on array indexing; no generate/genvar, and avoid unpacked arrays.
